decision.rule: call a client when P(subscribe) exceeds C/V
decision.chosen_on: training half, out-of-fold scores from the shipped configuration
decision.checked_on: held-out half, persisted artifact, after the choice was fixed
decision.why_not_f1: the F1 cut optimises a count of errors; the bank pays for calls and subscriptions, which is a price, not a rate
decision.why_not_accuracy: accuracy peaks at 0.5 on this class balance and would call almost nobody (D53, and T33's 801 missed subscribers)

assumptions.name: AGENT_COST_PER_HOUR_EUR
assumptions.note: Fully-loaded agent cost: wage, employer contributions, supervision, telephony. No bank figures are public, so this is a stated assumption.

assumptions.name: MINUTES_PER_CALL
assumptions.note: Dialling + talk + notes. Corroborated by this dataset: mean talk time (`duration`) is 258 s = 4.3 min, so 5.0 min total is not optimistic.

assumptions.name: AVERAGE_DEPOSIT_EUR
assumptions.note: Typical term deposit size. Not in the data: `balance` is the client's average yearly balance (median EUR 448), not the amount deposited.

assumptions.name: TERM_MONTHS
assumptions.note: Standard 12-month term used for the comparison.

assumptions.name: NET_INTEREST_MARGIN_ANNUAL
assumptions.note: Margin the bank keeps on the deposited funds.

assumptions.name: VALUE_PER_SUBSCRIPTION_EUR
assumptions.note: = AVERAGE_DEPOSIT_EUR * NET_INTEREST_MARGIN_ANNUAL * (TERM_MONTHS / 12). Conservative: excludes cross-sell and long-term customer value.
